translationRepairs: On gengzi day Virtuous Consort was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.
On gengzi day Empress Yide was posthumously titled Empress Xuanyi.

s0014 追懿德皇后為宣懿皇后 names her as Empress Yide (懿德皇后), already an empress title being posthumously changed to Empress Xuanyi; 'Virtuous Consort' invents a generic consort rank and drops the established title.
On yisi day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.
On yisi day the court paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.
s0066 太祖之高祖 is Taizu's great-great-grandfather; the next unit's 曾祖 is the great-grandfather, so rendering 高祖 as great-grandfather conflates the two generations.
On yisi day paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.
On yisi day paid respects at Taizu's temple; Taizu's great-great-grandfather was posthumously titled Emperor Zhaolie with temple name Suzu; his consort was titled Empress Zhaolie.
Same kinship error in the literal: 高祖 is great-great-grandfather, not great-grandfather.
In the first year of Tianqing, in the first spring month, the court angled for fish on the Yalu River.
In the first year of Tianqing, in the first spring month, the court angled for fish on the Huntong River.
s0158 鴨子河 is the Huntong River (as the matching literal already has); Yalu is 鴨綠江, a different river.
On renyin day Song Prince of Wei Heluwo was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.
On renyin day the Prince of Song and Wei, Heluwo, was made supreme commander of all armies and horses under heaven.
宋魏國王 is Heluwo's Liao dual princely title (Prince of Song and Wei), not a Song-dynasty 'Song Prince of Wei'.
Initially when Jurchen raised troops, Ashu of the Hesilie division did not follow; his division was sent Sagai to attack him.
Initially when Jurchen raised troops, because Ashu of the Hesilie division did not follow, they sent Sagai of their division to attack him.

The before is garbled and wrongly makes Ashu's side send Sagai; 遣其部撒改討之 means the Jurchen (subject of 起兵) sent Sagai of their division to attack him. The proposal's 'Aguda's division' invents Aguda, who is not named in s0215.
When they attacked Ningzhou, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.
When they attacked Ningjiang Prefecture, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.
甯江州 is Ningjiang Prefecture; omitting 江 as Ningzhou is a naming error.
When they attacked Ningzhou, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.
When they attacked Ningjiang Prefecture, the Northeast Route supreme command office reported it.
Same place-name error in the literal: 甯江州 is Ningjiang Prefecture, not Ningzhou.
Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningzhou; he was defeated.
Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningjiang; he was defeated.
甯江東 is east of Ningjiang; Ningzhou drops 江 and mismatches the place in s0224.
Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningzhou; he was defeated.
Xiao Tabuye encountered Jurchen and fought east of Ningjiang; he was defeated.
Same place-name error in the literal: 甯江東 is east of Ningjiang, not Ningzhou.

On the renyin new moon of the tenth winter month — [11]: Defender of the State Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.

On the renyin new moon of the tenth winter month — [11]: Acting Minister of Works Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.
守司空 is the acting/honorary Minister of Works (司空) rank; 'Defender of the State' is a different office and unsupported here.

Winter, tenth month, on renyin new moon — [11]: Defender of the State Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.

Winter, tenth month, on renyin new moon — [11]: Acting Minister of Works Xiao Sixian was made northeast route commander-in-chief; Jingjiang Army military commissioner Xiao Tabuye was deputy; three thousand Khitan and Xi troops, Central Capital forbidden troops and local strongmen two thousand, and more than two thousand martial men selected from all routes — with scout-commander Cui Gongyi as chief escort officer and Crane-Control commander Xing Ying as deputy — led the army to encamp at Chuhe Store.
Same office error in the literal: 守司空 is Acting Minister of Works, not Defender of the State.
On renchen day of the eleventh month Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Qinlin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.
On renchen day of the eleventh month Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Wolin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.
斡鄰濼 romanizes as Wolin Marsh; Qinlin misreads 斡鄰.
Eleventh month, on renchen day Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Qinlin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.
Eleventh month, on renchen day Commander-in-Chief Xiao Dili and others encamped east of Wolin Marsh and were again struck by Jurchen; very many soldiers died.
Same place-name error in the literal: 斡鄰濼 is Wolin Marsh, not Qinlin Marsh.
In the twelfth month Xian, Bin, Xiang, and the three prefectures and Iron Li and Wunai all rebelled and entered Jurchen.
In the twelfth month the three prefectures of Xian, Bin, and Xiang, as well as Iron Li and Wunai, all rebelled and went over to the Jurchen.
咸、賓、祥三州 means the three prefectures Xian, Bin, and Xiang themselves; the before wrongly treats those names as separate from 'the three prefectures'. 叛入女直 is well rendered as went over to the Jurchen.
Twelfth month, Xian, Bin, Xiang, and the three prefectures and Iron Li and Wunai all rebelled and entered Jurchen.
Twelfth month, the three prefectures of Xian, Bin, and Xiang, as well as Iron Li and Wunai, all rebelled and went over to the Jurchen.
Same parse error in the literal: 咸、賓、祥三州 are the three prefectures, not names plus a separate trio.
